title: Pacific
lyrics_plain:
I'm slowly sinking down in this ocean.
Life is shining in your eyes.
The past is only a memory.

Creating the mountains.
Creating the sea.
Believing in your heart.
Believing in me.

The world is a beautiful place.
The reason. The meaning that I'm living for.
This is my final stand.
I am no longer afraid to die.

I am no longer afraid to die.

Heaven waits for me.
Sons of the universe.
The land of your father is full of His glory.

We are sailing now together.
Together you and me.
Now love and hope is our flag.
The kingdom of the sea.

The world is a beautiful place.
The reason. The meaning that I'm living for.
This is my final stand.
I am no longer afraid to die.

I am no longer afraid to die.
